records.title: Adopter installs QPB into a target repo and validates the install
records.description: An adopter (or AI agent) installs QPB into a target repo and runs the Phase-0 install validator before any phase work. The validator must report status=ok only when the install layout is canonical and any populated quality/ carries a fresh active-run marker; ambiguous AI-tool markers must block until --ai-tool is given.
steps: Adopter installs QPB into the target repo
Agent runs python3 <install_root>/bin/qpb_validate.py <target> --ai-tool claude
Validator emits event= lines and a validation_complete status
Agent proceeds only on status=ok

records.title: Operator runs a Mode-B benchmark plan and the detached collector reaps and grades every run
records.description: A harness operator runs a benchmark plan; the orchestrator spawns detached AI-CLI runs and a detached collector reaps and grades each one. Every run must reach a correct terminal state and receipt; a still-waiting run must not be graded FAILED and a completed run must not be mislabeled.
steps: Operator invokes qpb_harness run-plan with a plan file
Orchestrator launches each run detached and writes manifest.json
Collector polls each run's PID, classifies a terminal state, and grades it
Operator reads SUMMARY.md and per-run grading.json

records.title: Operator caps concurrency per provider and the harness honors it under starvation
records.description: An operator with a metered API budget caps concurrency per provider. The harness must never run more than the cap of concurrent AI-CLIs per provider, including for retry-spawned (previously starved) runs.
steps: Operator passes --max-per-provider with per-provider caps
Harness reserves an inflight slot per run before spawning
Starved runs wait, then retry when a slot frees
Active-run count per provider never exceeds the cap

records.title: Operator watches live status to decide whether to intervene in a run
records.description: An operator watches the live status surface (qpb_harness status / TUI) to decide whether to intervene in a stuck run. The reported current phase must never exceed the phase actually completed.
steps: Operator runs qpb_harness status against a live harness run
Status surface resolves the current phase from sentinels or artifacts
Operator sees a phase number that reflects real progress
Operator intervenes if a run is wedged

records.title: Adopter overrides the Council roster
records.description: An adopter overrides the Phase-4 Council roster via ~/.qpb/config.json. A valid roster is used; a malformed override falls back safely to defaults; the Layer-2 2-of-3 majority remains well-defined.
steps: Adopter sets council_members in ~/.qpb/config.json
council_members() validates and returns the roster
A malformed value emits a WARN and falls back to defaults
Phase-4 Layer-2 majority is computed over the roster

records.title: A new run archives the prior run's quality/ as reference and starts clean
records.description: An operator (or AI) starts a new run on a repo with a populated quality/. The prior run is preserved under previous_runs/<ts>/ and the live quality/ starts clean, with no data loss and no hard abort on a recoverable collision.
steps: A run starts with a populated quality/ present
The prior quality/ is archived under quality/previous_runs/<timestamp>/
A fresh quality/ tree is created for the new run
No source outside quality/ is modified
